column1: # The cap of the text of an entry of the feed (FR-102), by language and by the kind of the entry:
# tag<TAB>update<TAB>news. Code points, line breaks not counted. An update is measured by the letter
# "Obnovlenie", a news item by "Novost" -- the only windows that show the whole text. Printed by the
# instrument of fitting (tests/ui_fit.rs, print_the_caps_of_the_feed with LANGSW_FEED_CAPS_WRITE);
# read by tools/sign-news.ps1, which refuses a longer text of that kind. 0 -- the letter does not
# fit even without a text in that language yet.
# Since 1.9.0 (stage E121, decision 208.244 p. 9) a fourth column, card: the words of an author's card of
# the view full (C1) -- its heading and at most two lines of the caption in the strip under the
# picture, 900 x 540. A card of the view panel (B) stands where a news item does: the column news.
